item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Sam Hunt Reveals the Real Reason He Has Not Released More Music
item.description: Sam Hunt shares his journey in country music, admitting his struggle with organization has slowed new releases, but improvements hint at fresh tunes on the horizon.

item.title: 'The Madison' Ending Explained: Is Stacy Clyburn Really Going To Do It?
item.description: If there's a problem with 'The Madison,' it's the thing that makes the show brilliant. Taylor Sheridan's new exploration in grief is too real.

item.title: Luke Combs Prioritizes Family Over Trying to Impress in the Music Business
item.description: Luke Combs shares his priorities, balancing family time with a busy career, while pushing back against the music industry's pressure to network for awards and recognition.

item.title: Charlie Kirk’s Mentor Jeff Webb Dead at 76 After Tragic Accident
item.description: Jeff Webb, a major force in the cheerleading world and a former mentor to late activist, Charlie Kirk, died after a pickleball accident.

item.title: U.S. Army Just Changed Who Can Enlist — And It’s a Major Shift
item.description: The U.S. Army is making major changes to enlistment rules, expanding who can serve and easing some restrictions.

item.title: WATCH: Ella Langley
item.description: Ella Langley enlisted a ton of celebrity guests, including Miranda Lambert and Luke Grimes, to co-star in her music video for 'Choosin' Texas.' She also dropped a couple of eye-catching Easter Eggs and teases.

item.title: Dan + Shay Aren’t Sure Fans Are Ready for Their New Song ‘Say So’
item.description: The country duo’s new song “Say So” comes from a deeply personal place — and they’re a little worried about how fans will take it.

item.title: Dan + Shay's New Song 'Say So' Is Heavy, Deeply Personal
item.description: Dan + Shay are back with new music and wow, it's tugging at our heartstrings. Their new song "Say So" comes from a deeply personal story for both singers.

item.title: REPORT: Red Lobster Mulls a Comeback for a Popular All-You-Can-Eat Deal
item.description: Red Lobster might bring back its popular endless shrimp promotion despite past losses, as new CEO Damola Adamolekun seeks ways to revitalize the brand and listen to hungry customers.

item.title: Charley Crockett's 'Age of the Ram' Album: The 8 Most Bone-Chilling Lyrics
item.description: Charley Crockett's new album, 'Age of the Ram,' takes an experimental approach to an age-old country story: The life and death of an outlaw.

item.title: Everything We Know About Taylor Swift And Travis Kelce's Wedding
item.description: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce are engaged and we've gotten a few breadcrumbs about their wedding planning.

item.title: Listen: Luke Grimes Recorded the Sweetest Song for His Son
item.description: There's plenty of pain on Luke Grimes new Redbird album, but a song he wrote for his son Rigel adds a bit of sweet you might not expect from the 'Marshals' star.

item.title: Fans Tattoo Country Stars' Autographs, But Will They Regret It Later
item.description: Some fans are tattooing country artists' autographs, but regrets often follow as careers can fade. Breland shares his thoughts on this impulsive trend during meet and greets.

item.title: What Is Breland Planning? Big Surprise In Store for Annual Charity Concert
item.description: Walker Hayes just signed on to play Breland & Friends next week in Nashville and it sounds like an even more popular artist is coming too.

item.title: This Baby Boutique Scam Is Rocking South Carolina — 15 Arrests + Counting
item.description: Authorities say dozens of customers paid for baby items they never received — and the arrests just keep adding up.
